content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the specific educational qualifications corresponding to their applied discipline as of 01.10.2026: Graduate Apprentice - Civil, Electrical, S&T: Graduate or equivalent in relevant Engineering/Technology streams. Graduate Apprentice - Human Resource: Full-time BBA from a recognized University. Graduate Apprentice - Finance: Full-time B.Com from a recognized University. Graduate Apprentice - Rajbhasha: Full-time BA (Hindi) from a recognized University. Graduate Apprentice - CSR: Full-time Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) from a recognized University. Graduate Apprentice - Legal: Full-time LLB (Bachelor of Law) from a recognized University. Graduate Apprentice - Information Technology (IT): Full-time B.Sc./BCA/B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science or Information Technology from a recognized University. Technician (Diploma) Apprentice - Civil, Electrical: Diploma or equivalent in relevant Engineering/Technology streams. The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum will be 30 years as on 01.10.2026. Result awaited, supplementary, or back paper candidates need not apply. Candidates who have undergone apprenticeship training in IRCON or any other organization are not eligible. Candidates who after completion of their education have undergone training or job experience of one year or more. Applicants who have completed more than three years after passing the qualifying examination as on 01.10.2026 (i.e., candidates passing the minimum educational qualification in 2026, 2025, 2024, and on or after 01.07.2023 are eligible).

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies available in IRCON Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 54 vacancies available, which include 36 Graduate Apprentices and 18 Technician (Diploma) Apprentices.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 05.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Graduate Civil Apprentices?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a degree or equivalent in relevant Engineering/Technology streams for Civil discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum limit is 30 years as on 01.10.2026, with relaxations for SC, ST, and OBC-NCL candidates.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this apprenticeship recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How is the selection of candidates carried out?
faq.answer: There are no interviews; eligible candidates are shortlisted based on a merit list prepared from marks secured in essential educational qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly stipend provided to apprentices?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices receive ₹ 14,000/- per month and Technician (Diploma) Holders receive ₹ 12,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job with IRCON?
faq.answer: No. After completion of the one-year apprenticeship program, the apprentice shall not have any claim for any employment with IRCON.

faq.question: Q9. Who is eligible to apply based on passing year?
faq.answer: Applicants who have passed the minimum educational qualification in 2026, 2025, 2024, and on or after 01.07.2023 are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be sent along with the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send self-attested photocopies of the Class X / Matriculation certificate, degree/diploma certificates and mark sheets, and community certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) if applicable.
